Age-Specific Fertility Rates dataset

Source: R/datasets.R
data_asfr.Rd

Data frame containing age-specific fertility rates (ASFR) for 201 countries, used in the MRC projections. Data cover the period 2020–2100.

Unit is children born per 1000 women per 5 years.

ASFR values are based on data from the United Nations 'World Population Prospects 2024 Revision' (medium variant), recalculated into 5-year periods.

  • Country_code. Code of country [standard ISO 3166-1] (numeric)

  • Period. Period for which the data is presented (character)

  • 10-14. ASFR for 10-14 age groups (numeric)

  • 15-19. ASFR for 15-19 age groups (numeric)

  • 20-24. ASFR for 20-24 age groups (numeric)

  • 25-29. ASFR for 25-29 age groups (numeric)

  • 30-34. ASFR for 30-34 age groups (numeric)

  • 35-39. ASFR for 35-39 age groups (numeric)

  • 40-44. ASFR for 40-44 age groups (numeric)

  • 45-49. ASFR for 45-49 age groups (numeric)

  • 50-54. ASFR for 50-54 age groups (numeric)

Format

Data frame with 3216 rows and 11 variables

References

United Nations, Department of Economic and Social Affairs, Population Division (2024). World Population Prospects 2024, Online Edition (Rev. 1). Available at: https://population.un.org/wpp/

See also

Other base_data: base_data_list, data_births_ratio, data_fertility_differentials, data_migration_destination, data_migration_rates, data_population, data_regions, data_structure, data_survivability, data_switching, info_variants
